Master Arkhar

Biography

Master Arkhar is a craftsman on Suslanger. He boasts of the quality of his tools, including instruments for scholars, and deals in weapons outside the ordinary legal trade. His workshop is one of the useful contacts available to Kir and Kel. [1]
